title: Sakkizoyoqning 3 ta yuragi va ko'k qoni bor

scenes.text: Ikkitasi qonni jabralar orqali haydaydi, uchinchisi esa butun tanaga.
Uning qoni ko'k, chunki unda temir emas, mis bor.
Shu ko'k qonni uchta yurak birga harakatlantiradi.

description: Sakkizoyoqning uchta yuragi bor: ikkitasi qonni jabralarga, bittasi butun tanaga haydaydi. Qonidagi mis tufayli u ko'k rangda.
source: https://www.livescience.com/how-many-hearts-does-an-octopus-have (two branchial hearts + one systemic heart; copper-based hemocyanin makes oxygenated blood blue)
